in_marathi.name: Gunita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gunita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gunita is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'gun', which means 'victory' or 'triumph'. This name is often given to girls to symbolize their strength and success in life. In Hindu mythology, Gunita is associated with the goddess Durga, who is known for her victory over evil.
